title.zh: ⚡️美财长贝森特：《GENIUS法案》是美国金融分水岭，OCC最终规则为创新与竞争提供清晰基础
title.en: ⚡️美财长贝森特：《GENIUS法案》是美国金融分水岭，OCC最终规则为创新与竞争提供清晰基础

current_state.zh: US Treasury Secretary Bessent called the GENIUS Act a watershed for American finance and said the OCC's final rule implements the stablecoin law by providing a clear, practical foundation for private-sector innovation and competition in digital assets.
current_state.en: US Treasury Secretary Bessent called the GENIUS Act a watershed for American finance and said the OCC's final rule implements the stablecoin law by providing a clear, practical foundation for private-sector innovation and competition in digital assets.
